edition.name: Migne, Patrologia Latina 5 (1844), via Latin Wikisource
edition.witness_note: Single locked witness in repo; second witness not yet locked.

source_text: Incolae coelorum futuri cum Deo Christo Tenente principium, vidente cuncta de coelo. Simplicitas, bonitas, habitet in corpore vestro. Irasci nolite sine causa fratri devoto: Recipietis enim quidquid feceritis ab illo. Hoc placuit Christo, resurgere mortuos, imo, Cum suis corporibus, et quos ignis ussit in aevo, Sex millibus annis completis mundo finito. Vertitur interea coelum tenore mutato: Comburuntur enim impii tunc igne divino. Ira Dei summi ardet creatura gemendo. Digniores, stemmate et generati praeclaro, Nobilesque viri sub Antichristo devicto: Ex praecepto Dei rursum viventes in aevo, Mille quidem annis ut serviant sanctis et Alto, Sub jugo servili, ut portent victualia collo; Ut iterum autem judicentur regno finito. Nullificantes Deum, completo millesimo anno, Ab igne peribunt, cum montibus ipsi loquendo. In bustis et tumulis omnis caro redditur acto, Demerguntur inferno, trahunt poenas in aevo. Ostenduntur illis, et legunt gesta de coelo Memoria prisca debito et merita digno. Merces in perpetuo secundum facta tyranno. Omnia non possum comprehendere parvo libello. Curiositas docti inveniet nomen in isto.
pass_a_gloss: The inhabitants of future heaven with God Christ holding the beginning, seeing all things from heaven. Let simplicity, goodness, dwell in your body. Do not be angry without cause with a devoted brother: for you will receive whatever you do from him. For this pleased Christ, to resurrect the dead, indeed, with their bodies, and those whom fire burned in the age, six thousand years completed world finished. Meanwhile, the heaven is turned with changed tenor: for the wicked are burned then by divine fire. The wrath of highest God burns the creature groaning. More worthy, of noble lineage and born of illustrious, and noble men under Antichrist defeated: living again by command of God in the age, a thousand years indeed so that they serve the saints and the High One, under servile yoke, so that they carry provisions on their neck; so that they are judged again with the kingdom finished. Those who nullify God, with the thousandth year completed, will perish from fire, with the mountains themselves speaking. All flesh is returned in the tombs and graves, they are submerged in hell, they drag penalties in the age. Their deeds are shown to them, and they read the deeds from heaven, from ancient memory and worthy merit. Reward in perpetuity according to deeds to the tyrant. I am not able to comprehend all things in a small book. The curiosity of the learned will find the name in this.
pass_b_english: The inhabitants of the future heaven are with God Christ, who holds the beginning and sees all things from heaven. Let simplicity and goodness dwell in your body. Do not be angry without cause with a devoted brother, for you will receive whatever you do from him. This pleased Christ, to resurrect the dead, indeed, with their bodies, and those whom fire burned in the age, six thousand years completed world finished. Meanwhile, the heaven is turned with a changed tenor, for the wicked are burned then by divine fire. The wrath of the highest God burns the creature, groaning. Those who are more worthy, of noble lineage and born of illustrious, and noble men under the Antichrist defeated, will live again by the command of God in the age, a thousand years indeed, so that they serve the saints and the High One, under a servile yoke, so that they carry provisions on their neck, so that they are judged again with the kingdom finished. Those who nullify God, with the thousandth year completed, will perish from fire, with the mountains themselves speaking. All flesh is returned in the tombs and graves, they are submerged in hell, they drag penalties in the age. Their deeds are shown to them, and they read the deeds from heaven, from ancient memory and worthy merit. The reward is in perpetuity according to deeds to the tyrant. I am not able to comprehend all things in a small book. The curiosity of the learned will find the name in this.
